description: Erection of a single storey rear infill and rear extension to the house.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (2207 00; 2207 50; 2207 01; 2207 51; 2207 02; 2207 52; 2207 03; 2207 53; 2207 04; 2207 54; 2207 05; 2207 55; 2207 06; 2207 56; 2207 07; 2207 57; 2207 58  Received:  14 July 2022) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the single storey rear infill and rear extension hereby approved.

Condition : 5 - The dwelling house, as enlarged and/or altered in accordance with this permission, shall only be used as a single unit of accommodation, and shall not be subdivided, separated or altered in any way so as to create two or more separate units of accommodation, without further grant of planning permission.
